about.heroSub: From a curious Computer Science student to a freelance developer trusted by real clients — here's how it happened.
about.lede: I started learning web development as part of my BS in Computer Science — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, out of pure curiosity for how websites actually came together.
about.paragraph1: That curiosity didn't stay a class assignment for long. Building and customizing websites for real clients became something I genuinely looked forward to, and over time it grew into a freelance career I've run alongside my studies ever since.
about.paragraph2: What makes me different is that I don't just build a website. I focus on responsive design, clean user experience, and local SEO — so my clients' sites don't just look good, they actually perform and get found.
about.missionQuote: My mission is to help businesses and individuals turn their ideas into professional, functional websites that grow their online presence.
